summary: Representation is explicitly treated as a blocking variable; operational sufficiency is action-dependent; executor estimates are within method and no pooled RD is primary.
red_flags: Rolling visible-carry-forward has no V3-valid answer-correct rows, so its within-method RD is not estimable.
open_questions: Whether methods with zero V3-positive rows should appear in the revised main table is a manuscript decision.
exclude_or_rerun: Do not report pooled executor RD as the primary effect.

findings.claim: The V3 plan fixes representation as a blocking/stratification variable.
findings.recommended_action: Report method-specific estimates and estimability flags.

findings.claim: Mandatory facts plus at least one admissible action option define operational sufficiency, and a selected answer path must be supported.
findings.recommended_action: Retain the 10-case invariance suite as a release gate.
